Latin word

ultrō

adverb

unprompted, of one’s own accord; unasked, of one’s own accord; making the first move

In this lexicon

    also used · classical

  • initiative

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Eun. 813: ubi nōlīs, cupiunt ultrō; Publil. Sent. B 1: ultrō sī offerās; Traupman 400
